newsitem.title: GREECE: XIOSBANK MANAGER WATSON LEAVES FOR POST ABROAD.
newsitem.headline: XIOSBANK MANAGER WATSON LEAVES FOR POST ABROAD.

text.p: David Watson, private Xiosbank's general manager is leaving the bank for personal reasons and will assume a new post abroad, Xiosbank said in a statement on Wednesday.
Replacing Watson as general manager will be Yiannis Pehlivanidis who headed products and customer service.
"Mr David Watson contibuted to Xiosbank's successful course and its establishment as a model bank for innovation and service," Xiosbank said.
Market sources said that Watson had joined Citibank, London, but this could not be confirmed immediately. --George Georgiopoulos, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
